page.overview:
Who is Dinosaurus?

David Anders, better known as Dinosaurus, is a major antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 4 and onwards.

He is a brilliant but mentally unstable human scientist who harbours a dissociative alter ego, transforming him into a powerful, red, humanoid dinosaur when his other persona takes control. As a radical utilitarian and lethal ecoterrorist, he believes that humanity can only survive and prosper if certain individuals are eliminated, justifying mass destruction as necessary for the greater good.

David Anders is a scrawny, ordinary-looking man.

Dinosaurus has a muscular, humanoid build with red skin, yellow eyes, and a long tail. His hands and feet have sharp claws capable of tearing through enemies, while his large, sharp yellow teeth and prominent crest give him a distinctly dinosaur-like appearance. Despite his humanoid physique, he closely resembles a Tyrannosaurus. Dinosaurus wears brown pants and armor covering his lower legs, shoulders, and tail.
